clue.text: Chief Greek epic for a thousand years

parts.note: Homer's Iliad is the great Greek epic of the Trojan War

explanation.surface: A Greek epic presented as the foremost one of the millennium.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiliad is a group of a thousand, especially a millennium of years.

clue.text: Sign of the cross

parts.note: reads as the Christian gesture, but means the mathematical symbol shaped like an upright cross used for addition

explanation.definitionFit: The addition symbol is a small upright cross, so it is literally a sign shaped as a cross.

clue.text: Woman beset by conflict in the laundry

indicators.note: a thing beset by another is surrounded by it, so the word for conflict wraps round the woman

parts.note: war is armed conflict
she is the pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A woman caught up in a quarrel while doing the washing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: someone or something found at work in the laundry, a person or machine that does the washing.
explanation.definitionFit: A washer is one who launders clothes, or a washing machine, both found where the laundry is done.

clue.text: Quick way to produce a crop

definitions.meaning: a faster route than the usual one
a close haircut, which crops the hair

explanation.definitionFit: A short cut is both a quicker route and a cropped hairstyle.

clue.text: Reprimand for leaving the mattress uncovered

definitions.meaning: ticking is the strong striped fabric that covers a mattress, so taking it off leaves the mattress bare

explanation.definitionFit: A ticking-off is a scolding, and read literally it is removing the mattress fabric.

clue.text: Writer goes to Jerusalem guest house

parts.note: a pen is something that writes
Sion (Zion) is a poetic name for Jerusalem

explanation.surface: An author travels to Jerusalem and stays at a boarding house.
explanation.definitionFit: A pension is a modest continental boarding house or small hotel.

clue.text: South American feature about grassland

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the facial feature surrounds the grassland

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
a lea is a meadow or grassland

explanation.surface: A geographical feature of South America surrounded by prairie.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chilean is a native of Chile, a South American country.

clue.text: Bound top dine out after tea

indicators.note: the rearranged eating word comes after the word for tea in the answer

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: out signals the letters of dine are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone obliged to eat at a restaurant once tea is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Bound and chained both describe someone restrained or tied up.

clue.text: Coppers get little satisfaction

definitions.meaning: ... idiomatically means a meagre return or little gain

explanation.definitionFit: Small change is loose low-value coins, and figuratively a trivial return.

clue.text: Rebel MP has reformed-so he swears

indicators.note: reformed means formed again in a new shape, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebellious politician has changed his ways, so he takes an oath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reformed' looks like moral improvement, but it is the anagram signal on REBEL, MP and HAS.
explanation.definitionFit: A blasphemer is one who curses profanely, speaking irreverently of sacred things.

clue.text: Frederick is so greatly heartened by a token of affection

indicators.note: the letters sit at the heart of the phrase, running across the end of the name and the next words

explanation.surface: Frederick is much cheered by a sign of love.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiss is a gesture expressing love or fondness.

clue.text: Previous examination of Beethoven's Sixth

parts.note: past means previous, gone by
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: An earlier study of a Beethoven symphony.
explanation.definitionFit: Beethoven's Symphony No 6 is known by the title the Pastoral Symphony.

clue.text: Malicious gossip from a novelist?

definitions.meaning: one who spreads spiteful rumours or tells on others
read literally, one who tells tales, as a fiction writer does

explanation.definitionFit: A tell-tale sneak spreads stories, while a writer of fiction literally recounts stories.

clue.text: Isn't capable of getting a girl into bed

indicators.note: into places the girl's name inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A man unable to get a woman into bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannot is the negative of can, meaning to be unable.

clue.text: Argument about entering changed situation

indicators.note: the abbreviation for about goes inside the word for a change

parts.note: an alteration is a change in how things stand
c (circa) is the abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: A row over moving into a new set of circumstances.
explanation.definitionFit: An altercation is a noisy quarrel or dispute.

clue.text: Duty to convey the monarch from train

indicators.note: to convey here means to carry within, so the tax word holds the queen

parts.note: excise is a duty or tax on goods
ER (Elizabeth Regina) stands for the queen

explanation.surface: Someone's job to escort the queen off a railway train.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise is to train or drill the body or a skill.

clue.text: Soft soap for a cleaning cloth

explanation.definitionFit: Flannel is both evasive flattery and a small washcloth.

clue.text: Bill needs consideration

explanation.definitionFit: An account is a statement of charges and also regard, as in taking something into account.

clue.text: Unwilling to be clad in Anglican dress

indicators.note: clad in means wrapped by, so the reluctant word sits inside the church letters

parts.note: CE stands for the Church of England
loth means reluctant

explanation.surface: Reluctant to wear Church of England vestments.
explanation.definitionFit: To clothe someone is to put garments on them.

clue.text: If I trace design, that shows cunning

indicators.note: design suggests the letters are laid out in a new pattern

explanation.definitionFit: Artifice is clever trickery or craft.

clue.text: Army picture of a military pageant?

definitions.meaning: a picture on the arm, playing on army as arm-related
a display of marching bands and drill by troops

explanation.definitionFit: A tattoo is an inked design on skin, often the arm, and an evening military display.

clue.text: A love for colour

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so nil

explanation.surface: A fondness for a particular colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Anil is the indigo plant and the blue dye made from it.

clue.text: Thought giant king should be included in official mention

indicators.note: the giant ruler is to be placed inside the formal commendation

parts.note: a citation is a formal mention, as for bravery
Og, king of Bashan in the Bible, was a giant

explanation.surface: Thinking that a huge monarch deserves an official commendation.
explanation.walkthrough: Og is the giant king of Bashan in the Old Testament, a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: Cogitation is careful deep reflection.

clue.text: Word of appreciation repeated for so long

indicators.note: repeated says the thank-you word is given twice

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: Saying thanks again and again for so much time.
explanation.definitionFit: Ta-ta is an informal British goodbye, like farewell.

clue.text: Cleric confronts Irish misfortune

parts.note: Rev. abbreviates reverend, a cleric
Erse is the Gaelic language of Ireland

explanation.surface: A priest faces an Irishman's bad luck.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverse is a setback or reversal of fortune.

clue.text: Great wealth brings good luck

explanation.definitionFit: A fortune is a large amount of money and also luck or chance.
